# Feijiang Han

> Research homepage and writing by Feijiang Han, a CS PhD student at the University of Maryland and a University of Pennsylvania alumnus. Research interests include actionable mechanistic interpretability, language models, model adaptation, and self-improving AI agents.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://feijianghan.com/): Current research, publications, background, and contact links.
- [Writing and reading guides](https://feijianghan.com/writing/): A directory of tutorials, guides, and research explorations in English and Chinese.
- [Publications](https://feijianghan.com/#publications): Selected highlights and the complete publication list. The full list is present in the page HTML.

## Open-source resources

- [PaperForge](https://github.com/FeijiangHan/PaperForge): An active paper-reading skill for reconstructing reasoning, understanding methods, checking assumptions, and developing research questions.
- [Top Conference Best Papers](https://github.com/FeijiangHan/Top-Conference-Best-Papers): A curated list of award-winning ML and NLP papers.
